metadata.name: classy-bosses
metadata.description:
Adds (COOL) Variants of Bosses!
Currently Has Skins For 4 Bosses Those Include: - Monstro(and their 2 other variants) - Haunt(and their 2 other variants) - Duke of Flies(and their 2 other variants) - Bloat(and their other variant)
You Can Alter The Chance of Skins Appearing Using The "Skin Machine"
!IMPORTANT NOTE! DOES NOT WORK WITH OTHER RESKIN MODS
(REP+)
